env BOLERO_MODULE=on
env sumdb=$BOLERO_SUMDB
env proxy=$BOLERO_PROXY
env BOLERO_PROXY BOLERO_NOPROXY BOLERO_SUMDB BOLERO_NOSUMDB

# basic fetch (through proxy) works
cp go.mod.orig go.mod
bolero get rsc.io/fortune@v1.0.0 # note: must use test proxy, does not exist in real world
rm $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/cache/download/sumdb # rm sumdb cache but NOT package download cache
rm go.sum

# can fetch by explicit URL
cp go.mod.orig go.mod
env BOLERO_SUMDB=$sumdb' '$proxy/sumdb-direct
bolero get rsc.io/fortune@v1.0.0
rm $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/cache/download/sumdb
rm go.sum

# direct access fails (because localhost.localdev does not exist)
# web.get is providing the error message - there's no actual network access.
cp go.mod.orig go.mod
env BOLERO_SUMDB=$sumdb
env BOLERO_PROXY=direct
! bolero get rsc.io/fortune@v1.0.0
stderr 'verifying module: rsc.io/fortune@v1.0.0: .*: no such host localhost.localdev'
rm $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/cache/download/sumdb
rm go.sum

# proxy 404 falls back to direct access (which fails)
cp go.mod.orig go.mod
env BOLERO_SUMDB=$sumdb
env BOLERO_PROXY=$proxy/sumdb-404
! bolero get rsc.io/fortune@v1.0.0
stderr 'verifying.*localhost.localdev'
rm $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/cache/download/sumdb
rm go.sum

# proxy non-200/404/410 stops direct access
cp go.mod.orig go.mod
env BOLERO_SUMDB=$sumdb
env BOLERO_PROXY=$proxy/sumdb-503
! bolero get rsc.io/fortune@v1.0.0
stderr '503 Service Unavailable'
rm $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/cache/download/sumdb
rm go.sum

# the error from the last attempted proxy should be returned.
cp go.mod.orig go.mod
env BOLERO_SUMDB=$sumdb
env BOLERO_PROXY=$proxy/sumdb-404,$proxy/sumdb-503
! bolero get rsc.io/fortune@v1.0.0
stderr '503 Service Unavailable'
rm $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/cache/download/sumdb
rm go.sum

# if proxies are separated with '|', fallback is allowed on any error.
cp go.mod.orig go.mod
env BOLERO_SUMDB=$sumdb
env BOLERO_PROXY=$proxy/sumdb-503|https://0.0.0.0|$proxy
bolero get rsc.io/fortune@v1.0.0
rm $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/cache/download/sumdb
rm go.sum

-- go.mod.orig --
module m
